name: Tom Stone
source:
Tom is a diamond in the rough. He just knows he's got some potential for something. He just needs to find out what that something is. Tom packed his bags at Tài's suggestion and transferred to Starswirl ready to make something of himself. For now, he's just a blank slate, ready to be shaped into something great. He may be a little thick-headed at times, but when it counts, he's a solid friend who'll never hesitate to help out.

[From [url=http://www.zap-apple.com/p/characters.html]the Starswirl Academy characters page[/url]]
